summary: This is a routine 6-K filing by NIO Inc. reporting unaudited financial results for Q1 2026. The press release covers vehicle deliveries (83,465 units), revenue of RMB25,532.7 million, gross margin of 19.0%, and net loss of RMB332.1 million. There is no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a standard quarterly earnings report, with no event triggering a special-situations classification.
